expectedText: I would like to take an evening course at a local college. I want to learn about geography because I enjoy reading about places and people. I plan to visit the campus to ask about the curriculum and the time of each lesson. A short lecture could introduce a topic, and a seminar could give students time to discuss it. I would like to do research about my neighborhood and write a report. I work during the day, so I want to avoid studying too late. I will finish my homework in two short sessions each week. If I need help with an assignment, I will ask the teacher for a tutorial.
